title: Historical Goal reader answers
description: Closed ephemeral answers of the seven historical Goal readers (SP-271, SP-277, SP-280, SP-300, SP-301, SP-302, SP-303). Newly authored owner contract under DL-045, 2026-11-04. Each $def belongs to one family only. An answer is internal and ephemeral: never persisted, never an event, receipt or command result.

goal_child_status_history_answer.$comment: Closed ephemeral answer of storage.goal_child_status_history_read.v1@1.0.0 (SP-271), adopting SP-420 for original admission. Equality joins between selector and original_event, and payload validity under pm.goal_runtime_event.goal_child_status_changed.schema.v2, are checked by scripts/pm_goal_history_reader_fixtures.py.
